summary: Find hidden words in fun puzzles. Play daily, train your brain, beat the clock!
description:
Train your brain and enjoy endless word puzzles!

Find all the hidden words by connecting the letters in the grid. Swipe across the screen to select words. Once found, they’ll be crossed off your list.

Choose from 8 difficulty levels and various search directions. Play with or without a timer and compete with friends and players around the world. All puzzles are generated automatically for infinite gameplay. Want to improve your spelling or learn a new language? Play in one of 13 supported languages!

🧠 Why you'll love Word Search:

  • ♾️ Endless puzzles – always fresh, never the same.
  • 🌍 Play in 13 languages: English, German, Spanish, French, Portuguese, Italian, Swedish, Norwegian, Finnish, Dutch, Danish, Czech, and Polish.
  • 📅 Puzzle of the Day – solve the same daily challenge with players worldwide.
  • 🏁 8 difficulty levels – from beginner to expert.
  • 🏆 Google Play Games integration – achievements & leaderboards.
  • 🎨 Customize your game theme and colors.
  • 🔍 5 new search categories: Animals, Colors, Food & Drink, Geography, and Plants.
  • ⏱️ Timer, countdown, or relaxed mode – you choose.
  • 📶 Works offline – keep playing anytime, anywhere.
  • 🆓 Free to play, unlock premium for ad-free gameplay and unlimited hints.

Are you a word master? Test your skills and see how fast you can find them all!
